code: (()=>{const rects=[];const vis=(n)=>{const c=getComputedStyle(n);if(c.display==='none'||c.visibility==='hidden'||parseFloat(c.opacity)<0.02)return false;return true;};const sel=['#hud .hud-bar','#hud .hud-banner','#hud .hud-loc','#hud .hud-glint','#run-screen .rn-shop','#run-screen .rn-shelf','#run-screen .rn-buttons','#hud .hud-slot','#hud .hud-port-cell'];for(const s of sel){for(const n of document.querySelectorAll(s)){const b=n.getBoundingClientRect();if(b.width<1||b.height<1)continue;if(!vis(n))continue;rects.push({s,n,x:+b.x.toFixed(1),y:+b.y.toFixed(1),w:+b.width.toFixed(1),h:+b.height.toFixed(1)});}}const over=[];for(let i=0;i<rects.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<rects.length;j++){const a=rects[i],b=rects[j];if(a.n.contains(b.n)||b.n.contains(a.n))continue;const ox=Math.min(a.x+a.w,b.x+b.w)-Math.max(a.x,b.x);const oy=Math.min(a.y+a.h,b.y+b.h)-Math.max(a.y,b.y);if(ox>1&&oy>1)over.push([a.s,b.s,+ox.toFixed(1),+oy.toFixed(1)]);}const vw=innerWidth,vh=innerHeight;const out=rects.filter(r=>r.x<-0.5||r.y<-0.5||r.x+r.w>vw+0.5||r.y+r.h>vh+0.5);return {tag:'fit',vw,vh,rects:rects.map(r=>({s:r.s,x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.w,h:r.h})),overlaps:over,offscreen:out.map(r=>({s:r.s,x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.w,h:r.h}))}})()
